inksight_wifi.tooltip: Join WiFi in STA mode (waits up to 15 s, auto-reconnect on); check the last-error block for the failure reason

inksight_setup.tooltip: Configure the InkSight backend address and device token (use your own address when self-hosting; token comes from website pairing and may be empty)

inksight_fetch.tooltip: Request /api/render and decode the bitmap over the network; WiFi must be connected first. Returns true on success

inksight_draw.tooltip: Draw the fetched 400x300 bitmap on the e-paper object; must sit inside a full-refresh draw section

inksight_ready.tooltip: Whether at least one fetch has succeeded

inksight_error.tooltip: Description of the most recent fetch failure ("ok" when successful)

inksight_pair.tooltip: Submit the website pairing code to the backend to confirm device ownership (empty skips); call after configuring the server

inksight_refresh_ms.tooltip: Refresh interval delivered by the server via X-Refresh-Minutes (default 15 minutes, clamped to 1..1440)

inksight_due.tooltip: Official scheduler: after the boot render it follows the persisted interval; a 10-minute online window (5 s polling) opens only after a successful pair-code submission

inksight_draw_color.tooltip: Color drawing (black/white/yellow, red approximated as yellow; falls back to B/W content automatically); must sit inside a full-refresh draw section

inksight_mode.tooltip: Active: polls every 5 s + heartbeat, website shows Active and instant push works; Interval: official power-saving default (10-min online window still opens after pairing)

inksight_changed.tooltip: Official anti-rewrite: returns false when the fetched image matches the screen, skipping the refresh to protect the e-paper

inksight_show_cached.tooltip: On fetch failure, redraws the last cached image (skipped when no cache or already shown)

inksight_led.tooltip: Optional: LED + resistor on a free GPIO (e.g. 4); blinks while WiFi is down/connecting, off otherwise; omit the block if no LED is wired

inksight_red_style.tooltip: How server-sent red (e.g. the current timetable column) renders on panels without a red channel: Yellow = third color, Black = inverted highlight；Same as yellow on panels without a red channel; shows real red on b/w/red panels

inksight_colors.tooltip: BW = colors=2, timetable highlights the current column fully inverted; Color = colors=3, server accents in red/yellow (BW-yellow panels look best in BW)
